notes: C-409f50fe (gpg-encrypt an archive and remove plaintext intermediates): build a reusable sealing script that snapshots a live export tree deterministically (sorted tar, fixed mtime, gzip -n) under /tmp only, seals it with gpg --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 --s2k-digest-algo SHA512 using a passphrase file, records the strongest cipher discovered from `man gpg`, and removes every plaintext intermediate. The verifier decrypts with the live passphrase, confirms OpenPGP packet cipher 9 and byte-identical extraction, scans /app and /tmp for leftovers, then reruns the script on hidden mutations (changed/added files including a nested directory and two different passphrases).
